source.authorityName: School examination paper (school not named); obtained from icseboard.org, originally from icseonline.com
source.notes: Scanned one-page school paper with no text layer (only the icseboard.org watermark); OCR corrected line by line against the page image. Header printed: "2nd INTERIM TEST, 2022 -2023 / CLASS 7 / COMPUTER / TIME : 40 MIN. / MARKS 20."; examYear 2023 is the later year of the printed session (the file name carries 080823-2023). Marks are printed only per group ([04], [04], [05], [02], [05]); in groups A-D the number of items equals the group total, so each item is recorded with 1 mark (marksSource SECTION_INSTRUCTIONS). Group E prints [05] for "Any two" of three questions, which would be 2½ per answer, so group E is kept as one 5-mark entry. Numbering restarts in each group, so the group letter is stored as the question number and the item number as the part. No school name printed. Watermark ignored. All questions are on MS Excel.
source.usage: School examination paper published on icseboard.org (originally icseonline.com); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to where it was obtained. Figures are not reproduced.
